fixed_algorithm_assessed: At each L10..14, take 8 evenly spaced response rows, compute I_sample=Dv_sample@Fv.T, score coordinate j by mean(I_sample[:,j]^2)*sum(R[j,:]^2), stable descending top224 then sorted scatter to original320. R is current physical right factor, including map at lazy L13/14. Reconstruction/common256/full outer read unchanged.
distinct_from_PRD: PRD scores signed-lambda-weighted factor energy and L10 U norm once. Proposed score uses actual per-layer response coefficients and current physical output norm.
read_algebra: Dv=lambda_plus*(t^2+s^2)=2*lambda_plus*(Pu^2+Pv^2), where t=Pu+Pv and s=Pu-Pv; old physical difference read is (Dv Fv^T) R.
cache_obstruction: Different selected row sets change B trees. Fresh tags/invalidations are required per layer; reusing static PRD cache would silently return stale arithmetic.
tariff_scope: Same historical shape sequences, metadata-only 720-byte numerical payload, no model/setup/predict/truth. Product prices use actual current tariffs. Sample cost is ordinary F32 matmul arithmetic; omits repeated scoring/gathers/current right-norm work and routing changes. Not whole-model measured saving.
available_cache: TRAIN16/259/277 capture contains only L10 full U, Fv, signed lambda and block roster; lacks Fu, actual Dv, read response row IDs, later current right bases. Existing vector features are L12..15 only. Actual per-layer score/error cannot be recovered from these archives.
accuracy_bound: For a dropped set E=I_drop@R_drop: ||E||F <= sum_j ||I[:,j]||2*||R[j,:]||2. Sampled diagonal scores are estimates and ignore cross-coordinate cancellation; cached U/Fv alone supplies no useful bound on actual read error.
decision: Park the per-layer sampled224 proposal as a >=0.5% route. Eight-row selection leaves about0.43..0.50% optimistic product headroom, before other new work and accuracy loss; static PRD already lost materially on MSE. No new capture justified solely to rescue this marginal ceiling.
smallest_falsification_if_reopened: One existing permitted parent call would need retain sampled and disjoint validation Dv rows plus current right-basis norms at L10..14; compare fixed adaptive224 against fixed PRD224 on held-out physical read error. This is a future proposed observation only, not authority to launch.
